card.name: Just before ratio statistics values
card.fires_on: The space or small joiner right after a ratio label such as HR, RR or 95% CI, just before the numeric value. Also seen on 'ratio' and 'of' in risk ratio phrases.

modes.label: Space before confidence interval
modes.description: A blank or equals sign after '95% CI:' or 'HR', where the number comes next.

modes.label: Inside ratio wording
modes.description: The word ratio or the word after it in descriptions of risk or hazard ratios.

card.writes: It suppresses the word 'ratio' and its variants, so the model does not repeat ratio and expects numbers next.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a ratio statistic such as a hazard ratio is about to be followed by its number.
